scenes.script:
Priya says: Miss Nova, koi puche 'When are you coming?' to English-ma reply kevi rite aapvo?
Miss Nova says: Kyarey pan 'I will return back on Monday' em nahi bolvanu.
Priya says: Ha, 'return back' nahi. Return no matlab ja coming back thay che. Banne sathe bolvu e ek common mistake che. Mare fakt 'I will return on Monday' kehvu joie.
Miss Nova says: Perfect! Ane tame to kehtha hata ke tamne English bilkul nathi aavadtu.
Priya says: Mane to bas badha judge karse eano darr hato! Pan Supernova AI par, hu tamari sathe privately practice karu chu.
Miss Nova says: Exactly. Hu tamari speech analyze karu chu ane tamara mate ek personalized plan banavu chu.
Priya says: Ane upar thi, e normal English classes karta saat ganu sastu che!

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been localized to romanized, code-mixed Gujarati. The multiplier '7 times cheaper' was converted to 'saat ganu sastu' using the natural Gujarati multiplier 'ganu'. Politeness levels are maintained with Miss Nova using polite plural forms ('tame', 'tamari') and Priya using respectful terms with her and friendly direct terms with the viewer. The hook opens naturally in Gujarati before presenting the English quote.
